1 volleyball player committed to Southern Wesleyan in 2026 as of Oct. 12
Prep Dig records show one player had committed to Southern Wesleyan volleyball in 2026 as of Oct. 12, 2026.
Friday, Oct 16
By M. B. Vandyke
Records from Prep Dig available as of Oct. 12, 2026, listed one player who had committed to play college volleyball at Southern Wesleyan in 2026.
Kennedy Haucke committed to the program.
The article covers qualifying Prep Dig commitment records dated in 2026 and available as of Oct. 12, 2026. The records do not confirm signing, enrollment, roster membership or current commitment status; the snapshot may not reflect later commitments.
2026 volleyball commitment to Southern Wesleyan
Kennedy Haucke
Commitment Date: July 26, 2026
